Instructions for activating the tile via ADB:

1. Make sure the device is connected to the computer and USB debugging is enabled.
2. Run the following commands on the computer:

 adb shell cmd statusbar add-tile %s
 adb shell cmd statusbar click-tile %s
 adb shell cmd statusbar remove-tile %s

3. After successful execution, the tile will be activated.

If you have Shizuku installed and activated, you can press the button below to run these commands directly on the device.
To execute commands via Shizuku, you need to grant permission. Open Shizuku and allow access to this app.

Do you really want to go to this page?

Your browser or social network client will be opened at the link:
%s

For full launcher functionality, system permissions are required:

📱 Method 1: Via ADB (recommended)
1. Connect your phone to a computer with ADB
2. Enable 'Developer options' in settings
3. Enable 'USB debugging'
4. Run the commands:

adb shell pm grant %s android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS
adb shell pm grant %s android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW

📲 Method 2: Via Shizuku
1. Install Shizuku from the store
2. Launch and activate it
3. Return to this app

• Access to contacts and calls
• Access to call history
• Access to SMS messages
• Access to calendar
• Access to phone status
• Access to media files (photos, videos, audio)
• Permission to display over other windows
